serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
This should do.
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile
Lady Annalie: Wow. Did you really think that a few pairs of socks and panties would solve this? Do you take me for such a cheap woman?
You: Oh, come on. They are overpriced anyway. 
Lady Annalie: Overpriced…{{wi}} We don’t use that word around here.
Ok. This is going terribly. I should’ve spent some time preparing a strategy after all…
You: Come on, Annalie-
Lady Annalie: It’s Lady Annalie for you.
Our relationship seems to have regressed a lot. It’s true what they say, money changes how people treat you.
I didn’t suspect that the island thing would be such a touchy topic for her. I feel like I’m missing something…
You: Even if I and {f_botName} leave this place, we will still be friends! You don’t have to worry.
Lady Annalie: How compassionate! I can’t wait for your calls every Tuesday between brunch and Pilates!
